name: Claude Code
description: A command-line and IDE-integrated AI coding agent from Anthropic that reads and maps codebases, writes and edits code, runs tests, and can open pull requests, asking permission before changing files or running commands.
basePrice: Freemium — included with Claude Pro/Max plans; Team plan $20/seat/mo (annual); pay-as-you-go via API also available
useCase: AI pair programmer for writing code, fixing bugs, and automating multi-step dev workflows

name: Hugging Face
description: A collaborative hub where ML practitioners publish and discover models, datasets, and demo apps (Spaces), built on Hugging Face's own open-source libraries, with hosted inference and compute available.
basePrice: Freemium — unlimited free public hosting; Team & Enterprise from $20/user/mo; GPU compute from $0.60/hr
useCase: Hosting, sharing, and running machine learning models and datasets

name: DeepSeek-R1
description: An open-weight reasoning model trained with large-scale reinforcement learning to perform strong chain-of-thought reasoning on math, coding, and logic tasks, released under the MIT license for commercial use and distillation.
basePrice: Freemium — open-source weights free to self-host; official API billed per token (current models ~$0.15-$1.98/1M tokens; R1-specific legacy pricing no longer listed)
useCase: Open-source reasoning model for math, code, and complex logic tasks

name: Kimi K2
description: A trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Moonshot AI (1T total/32B activated parameters, 128K context) built for agentic tasks like tool use and multi-step reasoning, released under a modified MIT license.
basePrice: unknown — K2-specific API pricing no longer published; the chat app at kimi.com is free to use
useCase: Open-weight LLM for agentic tool use and autonomous coding/reasoning tasks

name: Google AI Studio
description: Google's free, web-based environment for experimenting with and prototyping on the Gemini family of multimodal models, including generating API keys and testing a 1-million-token context window.
basePrice: Freemium — free to use in-browser; production use goes through the Gemini API's own paid tiers
useCase: Prototyping and testing applications built on Google's Gemini models

name: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI's conversational AI assistant that answers questions, drafts and edits text, helps with code, and can analyze images and files through a chat interface on web and mobile.
basePrice: Freemium — Free tier; Plus from $20/mo
useCase: General-purpose AI chat assistant for writing, research, and coding help

name: Notion AI
description: A built-in assistant inside Notion's workspace that can chat, draft and edit content, summarize meetings, run recurring tasks through custom agents, and search across connected apps.
basePrice: Freemium — included trial on Free plan; fuller AI features bundled with paid Business plan
useCase: AI-powered workspace assistant for notes, docs, and team knowledge management

name: Character.AI
description: A platform for creating and chatting with AI-generated characters, letting users have open-ended conversations and interactive stories with both user-made and popular personas.
basePrice: unknown — official site does not publish a price; a paid tier is widely reported elsewhere but unconfirmed on character.ai itself
useCase: Chat and roleplay with AI-generated characters

name: Microsoft Copilot
description: An AI assistant that chats, answers questions with cited web search results, and drafts content or images, usable for free with a Microsoft account across web, Windows, and mobile.
basePrice: Freemium — Free with a Microsoft account; Microsoft 365 Premium from $19.99/mo
useCase: AI chat assistant for search, content creation, and everyday productivity

name: HubSpot CRM
description: A customer relationship management platform for tracking contacts, deals, and pipelines, with built-in AI features (the Breeze assistant) that summarize records, draft emails, and prep reps for calls.
basePrice: Freemium — Free plan; Starter from $15/mo/seat, Professional from $50/mo/seat
useCase: Customer relationship management with AI-assisted sales and marketing tools

name: Canva
description: A browser-based design platform with AI woven into its editor — Magic Write, Magic Eraser, Background Remover, and an AI image generator let people produce presentations, social posts, and print materials without design skills.
basePrice: Freemium — Free plan; paid tiers from regional pricing (site showed INR), roughly comparable to other freemium design tools
useCase: AI-assisted graphic design and content creation

name: Gamma
description: An AI platform for turning a text prompt into a presentation, document, social visual, or simple website — it drafts an outline, designs the layout, and lets you keep refining the result through chat.
basePrice: Freemium — Free plan; paid Plus/Pro/Ultra tiers (site showed regional INR pricing)
useCase: AI-generated presentations, documents and websites from a prompt

name: QuillBot
description: An AI writing assistant bundling paraphrasing, grammar checking, AI-content detection, plagiarism checking, text humanizing, summarizing and citation generation into one suite.
basePrice: Freemium — Free plan; Premium from regional pricing (site showed INR)
useCase: AI paraphrasing and writing improvement

name: Zapier
description: A no-code automation platform connecting thousands of apps into workflows, extended with an AI orchestration layer (Zapier MCP and agent-built workflows) so AI assistants can trigger multi-step actions across a company's other tools.
basePrice: Freemium — Free forever (100 tasks/mo); Professional from $19.99/mo, Team from $69/mo
useCase: No-code app integration and workflow automation

name: Semrush
description: An SEO and digital-marketing platform whose Content and AI Visibility tools use AI to suggest and score topic ideas, optimize drafts in real time, and track how a brand is mentioned inside AI search answers.
basePrice: Freemium — Free plan; SEO plan from $117.33/mo billed annually (list price $139/mo)
useCase: SEO, content optimization and AI-search brand visibility tracking

name: Gemini
description: Google's multimodal AI assistant that chats, generates images and video, and plugs directly into Gmail, Docs, and other Google apps to help with everyday and work tasks.
basePrice: Freemium — Free tier; paid Google AI Plus/Pro/Ultra plans (regional pricing)
useCase: General-purpose AI assistant across Google's ecosystem

name: Grok
description: xAI's conversational assistant built around live web and X search, step-by-step/multi-agent reasoning, voice conversations, and built-in image and video generation.
basePrice: Freemium — free to try; SuperGrok paid upgrade for higher limits (exact price not published)
useCase: Real-time web/X search and reasoning assistant

name: Claude
description: Anthropic's AI assistant for carrying out multi-step work such as building documents, spreadsheets, and slides, with dedicated coding support and integrations across common work tools.
basePrice: Freemium — Free; Pro $17/mo (annual) or $20/mo monthly; Max from $100/mo
useCase: AI assistant for coding, documents, and agentic work tasks

name: NotebookLM
description: A Google research tool that grounds its answers only in sources you upload, turning them into summaries, slide decks, mind maps, or narrated audio/video overviews.
basePrice: Free — standard usage included free; higher limits bundled into paid Google AI plans
useCase: Source-grounded research and study/notebook assistant

name: Qwen
description: Alibaba Cloud's free multimodal AI assistant offering chat, image/video generation, natural-language web development, and an agentic 'Deep Research' mode for multi-step report writing.
basePrice: Free
useCase: General AI assistant with chat, coding, and multimodal generation

name: Runway
description: A cloud-based AI content platform where individuals and enterprises generate and edit video, images, and audio in one workspace, backed by Runway's own foundation models and an API for developers.
basePrice: Freemium — from $15/mo (Standard; $12/mo billed yearly)
useCase: AI-generated and edited video, image, and audio content

name: ElevenLabs
description: An AI audio platform for generating lifelike speech, cloning and designing voices, composing music and sound effects, dubbing content across languages, and deploying conversational voice agents.
basePrice: Freemium — from $6/mo (Starter)
useCase: AI text-to-speech, voice cloning, and conversational voice agents

name: Stable Diffusion
description: Stability AI's open-weight family of text-to-image models, usable self-hosted, through Stability's API, or in their Stable Assistant web app, with editing tools for inpainting, outpainting, and upscaling.
basePrice: Freemium — free under Stability's Community License (<$1M annual revenue); custom pricing for Enterprise license
useCase: Open-weight AI image generation and editing

name: Midjourney
description: A subscription-only AI image and video generator from an independent research lab, used through its web app or Discord to produce stylized, highly imaginative visuals from text prompts.
basePrice: Paid — from $10/mo (Basic; $8/mo billed yearly)
useCase: AI-generated art, images, and short video

name: Adobe Firefly
description: Adobe's all-in-one generative AI studio for creating and editing images, video, audio, and designs using Adobe's own models plus partner models, integrated with Creative Cloud and Adobe Express.
basePrice: Freemium — free daily generations with no plan; paid plans from roughly $10/mo (regional pricing shown)
useCase: AI-generated and edited images, video, audio, and designs inside the Adobe ecosystem
